# NPS Tracker (stolenfocus)

> Comprehensive tracker for the National Pension Service (NPS) of Korea's stock holdings — both Korean (KOSPI/KOSDAQ) and US (SEC 13F) — with backtested momentum strategies and global superinvestor cross-references.

Bilingual site (Korean / English). All data sourced from official disclosures:
- DART (Korea Financial Supervisory Service Electronic Disclosure)
- SEC 13F filings (US institutional holdings)

## Key Facts

- Operator: National Pension Service (국민연금공단, NPS) — South Korea's national pension fund, AUM approximately ₩1,607 trillion (2026)
- Asset allocation (2026): Overseas stocks 35.7%, Domestic stocks 24.6%, Domestic bonds 18.5%, Alternatives 14.6%, Overseas bonds 6.3%, Cash 0.3%
- US holdings: 561 stocks, $135.07B (2025 Q4)
- Korean holdings: 1,200+ companies (DART tracked)
- 10-year average return: 8.48%

## Site Structure

- /ko/feed — Daily NPS DART disclosures (Korean)
- /en/feed — Daily NPS DART disclosures (English)
- /ko/global, /en/global — NPS US holdings + global superinvestor 13F cross-reference (Berkshire Hathaway, etc.)
- /ko/streak, /en/streak — Stocks NPS has been increasing for consecutive quarters
- /ko/company/[code] — Individual company pages with full NPS stake history (576+ companies)
- /ko/portfolio, /en/portfolio — NPS portfolio composition visualization
- /ko/compare, /en/compare — Compare NPS holdings vs other indices

## Common Questions

Q: How much of Samsung Electronics does NPS own?
A: Approximately 7.26% of Samsung Electronics (005930) — 16.7% of NPS Korean equity portfolio.

Q: What is NPS Momentum strategy?
A: A backtested investment strategy: select Top 30 stocks NPS most recently added (by shares × price), filter for positive 6-month momentum, then buy the 6 cheapest. 5-year hold. 100% win rate across 27 rolling 5-year windows (2014-2026 backtest). Source: nps-tracker backtest.

Q: How can I see NPS US stock holdings?
A: NPS files SEC 13F quarterly. The most recent quarter (Q4 2025) shows top US holdings: NVDA ($9.34B / 6.92%), AAPL ($8.21B / 6.08%), MSFT ($7.02B / 5.20%), AMZN ($4.58B / 3.39%), GOOGL ($3.90B / 2.89%).

Q: When does NPS file new holdings?
A: US holdings: 45 days after each quarter end via SEC 13F. Korea: continuously via DART 5%+ shareholding reports.
